items.title: Elvin Jones — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: He was playing drums with Duke like Lionel Hampton’s drummer would play.

ctx.x: You I never knew the guy’s name cause he wasn’t very friendly. He was a fellow from Philadelphia. He was a good drummer though. He was playing drums with Duke like Lionel Hampton’s drummer would play. You know, the heavy back beat. And I said, “That’s terrible.” I don’t know why he didn’t have any better of a…he couldn’t assimilate or interpret a composition better than that. Cause Duke, the music didn’t call for that.
So you got to Frankfurt, Germany and you saw the Duke Ellington Orchestra playing with this other drummer? Or were you asked to come up on the bandstand?
